pattern.description: The customer's short 'Please' reply (bubble plus avatar, right-aligned) appears below the agent's question, fading in while rising a short distance and decelerating into place.
pattern.why_premium: It reuses the same fade-and-rise message grammar as the agent replies, so customer and agent turns read as one consistent live chat; the decelerating settle keeps it calm.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.msg-customer-please', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 24}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'expo.out'}); bubble and avatar share the tween.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 140, mass: 1}}); style={{opacity: p, transform: `translateY(${interpolate(p, [0, 1], [24, 0])}px)`}} on the bubble+avatar row.
